summary: Iteration 73 - Team Management (Collaborateurs) feature fully tested. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with all CRUD operations working correctly. Fixed a bug in team.py where user.get('id') should be user.get('_id') for proper syndic parent identification.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX APPLIED: team.py _get_syndic() was using user.get('id') but get_current_user() returns user['_id']. Fixed to use user.get('_id') or user.get('id') for compatibility.
- GET /api/team/members: Returns list of gestionnaires for current syndic - VERIFIED
- POST /api/team/members: Creates gestionnaire with role_template_id and copropriete_ids - VERIFIED
- PUT /api/team/members/{id}: Updates name, copropriete_ids, role_template_id, password - VERIFIED
- DELETE /api/team/members/{id}: Removes gestionnaire from team - VERIFIED
- GET /api/admin/role-templates: Returns list of available role templates - VERIFIED
- Team section visible in Mon Bureau page with 'Ajouter' button - VERIFIED
- Add dialog with mode selector (direct/invitation), name, email, password, profile dropdown, ACP checkboxes - VERIFIED
- Direct mode sets password and must_change_password=false - VERIFIED
- Invitation mode hides password field and sets must_change_password=true - VERIFIED
- Edit dialog shows member data with email disabled - VERIFIED
- Delete confirmation and removal from list - VERIFIED
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary gestionnaire users for testing, then clean up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 73 verified the Team Management (Collaborateurs) feature. The Mon Bureau page at /mon-bureau includes a TeamSection component that allows syndics to manage their gestionnaires. Full CRUD operations work correctly. A bug was fixed in team.py where user.get('id') was changed to user.get('_id') or user.get('id') for proper syndic parent identification.
